description: Google Ads API lets developers manage ad campaigns, keywords, and reporting for Google Ads accounts.
access_notes: A developer token is required for all access. 'Test' level is immediate/self-serve for a test account. 'Basic' access is now automated -- reviewed within minutes after brand verification. 'Standard' (full production) access requires a manual review by Google. So the ceiling of usable access is gated, even though getting started is not.
api_notes: Campaigns, ad groups, keywords, reporting/reach-forecasting -- a large, well-documented API surface across REST and gRPC client libraries.
main_blocker: Standard (full production) access requires Google's manual review of the developer token application; Basic access is enough for many use cases and is now automated.
correction_note: Corrected during verification stage: original V2 research pass (search-only, no MCP-specific query run for this app) missed Google's official read-only Google Ads MCP server (github.com/googleads/google-ads-mcp, released Apr 2026). Original value was mcp_status=NONE_FOUND; see docs/verification.md.
